title: Every page that sets its own openGraph dropped og:site_name and og:locale, because Next replaces the root block instead of merging it

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven seo-metadata finder; SCAN-657 fixed the help pages and pointed here for the rest

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven). app/layout.tsx sets siteName and locale on the root openGraph, and Next does not deep-merge nested metadata objects, so every page or layout that defined its own openGraph (58 files under app/ and lib/) published without og:site_name and og:locale. CLOSED 2026-10-05 as one mechanical sweep: lib/site.ts exports OG_SITE ({ siteName, locale }) and every openGraph block spreads it first, so a page can still override either key; a scripted, lint-checked edit with no other change. The probe walks app/**/{page,layout}.tsx for a block that neither carries siteName nor spreads OG_SITE.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const path=require("path");const out=[];const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(p)}else if(/^(page|layout)\.tsx$/.test(e.name)){const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");let i=s.indexOf("openGraph: {");while(i>=0){const block=s.slice(i,i+900);if(!/siteName|[.]{3}OG_SITE/.test(block))out.push(p);i=s.indexOf("openGraph: {",i+12)}}}};walk("app");const u=[...new Set(out)];if(u.length){console.error("SCAN-659: "+u.length+" page/layout file(s) set an openGraph block without siteName or the OG_SITE spread, so og:site_name and og:locale from the root are dropped there (Next replaces nested metadata objects; it does not merge them). First: "+u.slice(0,5).join(", "));process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Walks app/**/{page,layout}.tsx; fails on main, passes with the sweep.
